title: Korea In January: What To Wear And Do
summary: Korea in January can bring freezing Seoul nights and icy pavements. Learn what to pack and where to find more snow.

slides.title: January: Pack Layers
slides.voice: Korea in January can hit minus ten. Pack layers.

slides.title: Dress For The Cold
slides.sub: Padded coat, thermals, gloves, grippy shoes
slides.voice: Wear a long padded coat over thermal layers. Add gloves, a hat, scarf, and shoes with good grip.
slides.photo_query: winter clothing padded coat gloves thermal layers

slides.title: Watch Your Step
slides.voice: Indoors is strongly heated, so dress in layers you can remove. Watch for ice on shaded pavements.

slides.title: Head To Gangwon
slides.voice: For a snow day, head to Gangwon: its mountains get more snow than Seoul. Ski resorts run roughly December to early March.
